# Renderme AI

> Renderme AI is a mobile-first AI photo editor, face-swap tool, and graphic design studio. Upload a photo or type a prompt and get a hyper-realistic edit — or generate flyers, posters, logos, social posts, YouTube thumbnails, business cards, and Google ads — in under 30 seconds. Straight from your phone.

Renderme AI runs as an installable progressive web app at https://renderme.site. Users get 3 free edits to start; premium unlocks unlimited generations, the Designer Studio, and faster models.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, before/after showcase, install instructions, and prompt guide.
- [Welcome](/welcome): Same as the home landing page — features, demo video, and call to action.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Email + Google authentication for new and returning users.
- [Photo Editor](/app): Main editor — upload a photo, write a prompt, and generate AI edits.
- [Face Swap](/face-swap): Dedicated workflow for swapping faces between two photos (up to 4 faces).
- [Designer Studio](/designer): Generate flyers, posters, logos, IG posts/stories, FB covers, X posts, LinkedIn banners, YouTube thumbnails, Google ads, and business cards from a prompt.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How Renderme AI handles uploaded images and personal data.

## Optional

- [Reset password](/reset-password): Set a new password from a recovery email link.
